core_finding: The broad idea of darkness-front, shadow-boundary, optical-vortex, or phase-singularity superluminal motion is already present in the literature and popular science coverage. The repository may still be useful as a schema/test-harness/null-test artifact, but that narrower contribution requires either a completed novelty review, expert validation, or real measured data.

annotated_sources.title: Superluminal correlations in ensembles of optical phase singularities
annotated_sources.relevance: Direct overlap. The paper reports direct ultrafast measurement of optical phase singularity ensembles and velocities exceeding the speed of light before annihilation.
annotated_sources.novelty_effect: Blocks broad novelty claims about darkness-like optical singularities moving superluminally.

annotated_sources.title: What’s faster than light? Darkness
annotated_sources.relevance: Direct popular-science framing. Describes dark spots, optical vortices, and phase singularities as darkness-like structures that can appear superluminal.
annotated_sources.novelty_effect: Blocks ordinary-language novelty claims using the phrase speed of darkness unless the repository sharply distinguishes itself.
